// REQ: LANG-2561 LANG-2562 LANG-2563 LANG-2564
module 0x1::greeter {
    use std::string;
    /// A greeting
    struct Greeting has key, store { text: string::String, count: u64 }
    public entry fun create(account: &signer) {
        let g = Greeting { text: string::utf8(b"Hello"), count: 0x1F };
        move_to(account, g);
    }
    public fun count(addr: address): u64 acquires Greeting {
        borrow_global<Greeting>(addr).count
    }
}
